Breaking changes (1):
  • [1.30.0] Gateway API CRDs must be upgraded to `v1.5.x`: Istio 1.30 upgrades its Gateway API dependency to `v1.5.1` and reads `TLSRoute` and `ReferenceGrant` from the…  (migration · heuristic/medium · ev-fc883937720b)

Migration requirements / action required (6):
  • [1.30.0] CNI Agent respects excludeNamespaces configuration: Previously, only the CNI Plugin respected the excludeNamespaces config by skipping the processing of…  (migration · declared · ev-422554735c2d, ev-38314843847c)
  • [1.30.0] CNI config file permissions changed to 0600: The default file permissions for CNI config files written by Istio have changed from 0644 to 0600  (migration · declared · ev-159e117af892, ev-f5df9782e0bf)
  • [1.30.0] Sidecar proxy service namespace selection changed: When configuring sidecar proxies if a hostname exists in multiple namespaces, Istio now prefers Kubernetes…  (migration · declared · ev-f1035c3f4e9a, ev-d4fd02d1cd02)
  • [1.30.0] Untaint controller: If you enabled untaint controller using `taint.enabled` Helm value when deploying `istiod` chart, you previously also had to set the…  (migration · declared · ev-bd41994e0937, ev-a2cc6f3de927)
  • [1.30.0] XDS debug endpoints now require authentication: XDS debug endpoints (syncz, config_dump) on port 15010 now require authentication  (migration · declared · ev-018198b3706c, ev-205875f3da3e)
  • [diff] Kubernetes support narrowed: 1.31–1.35 → 1.32–1.36 (drops 1.31)  (compatibility · computed · ev-70e0aeb1a3cc, ev-461e1cdb22e4)

Security changes (9):
  • [1.30.0] Fixed XDS debug endpoint to pass caller namespace for proper authorization checks  (security · declared · ev-183b1c6cea8d)
  • [1.30.0] Fixed XDS debug endpoints (`istio.io/debug/syncz`, `istio.io/debug/config_dump`) served by StatusGen to enforce same-namespace authorization for non-system…  (security · declared · ev-33e199aebb0b)
  • [1.30.0] Fixed XDS debug endpoints (syncz, config_dump) to require authentication  (security · declared · ev-7aaffc93aa8e)
  • [1.30.0] Fixed a critical security vulnerability where Istio's JWKS fallback mechanism leaked an RSA private key, allowing attackers to forge JWT tokens and bypass…  (security · declared · ev-a0be83a11d06)
  • [1.30.0] Fixed an authorization bypass in `AuthorizationPolicy` matching for SPIFFE identities and namespaces  (security · declared · ev-10e11e5f2933)
  • [1.30.0] Fixed an authorization bypass in `AuthorizationPolicy` where regex metacharacters in certain identity fields were embedded in the generated Envoy `SafeRegex`…  (security · declared · ev-14f444735ff1)
  • [1.30.0] Fixed potential SSRF in WasmPlugin image fetching by validating bearer token realm URLs  (security · declared · ev-5419528c286d)
  • [1.30.0] ISTIO-SECURITY-TBD: Fixed JWKS private key leakage vulnerability When RequestAuthentication JWKS fetch failed (network issues, invalid URLs, rate limits)…  (security · declared · ev-ec919a712735)
  • [1.30.1] CVE-2026-47774 (CVSS score 7.5, High): An unauthenticated remote attacker can cause denial of service by exhausting memory in the Envoy process  (security · declared · ev-3cba3ccb113a)
